text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy ran hard through the 
Kikuka-sho. Later on, she witnessed 
Symboli Kris S clinch back-to-back 
victories in the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Moved to the core by that heroic figure, 
she felt all the more inspired as she 
thought of the impending showdown.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
The next objective is Symboli Kris S's 
retirement race—the Arima Kinen.
